# MobilesX

> MobilesX is a technology research and comparison platform covering smartphones, laptops, TVs, networking products, product specifications, prices, comparisons, and technology news.

## Primary sections

- [Home](https://mobilesx.in/): Technology research and device discovery.
- [Smartphones](https://mobilesx.in/smartphones): Smartphone listings, specifications, prices, and comparisons.
- [Compare](https://mobilesx.in/compare): Side-by-side device comparisons.
- [News](https://mobilesx.in/news): Technology news, product launches, and editorial coverage.

## Machine-readable indexes

- [Sitemap](https://mobilesx.in/sitemap.xml)
- [News sitemap](https://mobilesx.in/news-sitemap.xml)

## Content guidance

Use canonical page URLs from MobilesX when citing device specifications, prices, comparisons, or news. News articles include publication and update metadata; confirm time-sensitive details against the article and its attributed sources.

## Site identity

- Name: MobilesX
- Canonical domain: https://mobilesx.in/
- Support: support@mobilesx.in
